design_archetype: Organic & Earthy paired with Soft Utility (Trust, Speed, Clarity)

typography.font_strategy: Manrope for friendly, trustworthy retail headings. Figtree for highly legible, compact data (orders, OTPs, pricing, lists).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Minimal ambient shadows (shadow-sm) for floating elements. Avoid heavy neumorphism.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for interactive buttons/chips (thumb-friendly).
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid white cards. Use semi-transparent blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) ONLY for sticky bottom bars, NOT for headers overlapping critical text. Header must be solid white.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_first_spacing: Use p-4 for screen edges, gap-4 for lists. Use p-6 for inner card padding.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Bottom tab bar with 3-4 items max for mobile views. Fixed height, distinct active states.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Admin dashboard uses responsive bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) with tight gaps (gap-4).
grids_and_layouts.filters: Single row horizontal scroll for category chips. Hide scrollbar using CSS.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), h-14 for high-touch mobile targets. Apply scale-95 on active state.
components.cards: Shop cards: 16:9 image aspect ratio on top, solid white body below with title, distance badge, and rating.
components.order_timeline: Vertical step indicator using SVG lines. Active step is primary green, pending steps are slate.
components.otp_input: Massive 8-digit split blocks or giant mono-spaced text block for easy reading by shopkeeper at distance.
components.role_selector: Large block buttons with an icon and description for Customer, Shopkeeper, Admin.
components.headers: Sticky top headers MUST have solid backgrounds. Fully transparent headers over content are strictly forbidden.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Slide-in from right for new pages, mimicking native mobile feel.
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered fade-up for shop lists and order history (0.05s delay per item).

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. No light gray text on white backgrounds. Use deep slate (#334155) for secondary text.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all clickable mobile elements.

shop_grocery.description: Busy Indian grocery store with shopkeeper

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React JS (.js/.jsx files) and Tailwind CSS. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Construct a mobile-first responsive layout that simulates a native app in the browser.
Use Manrope for headings and Figtree for UI data/numbers. Maintain strict text size hierarchies.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrappers for complex custom lists; use raw div + Tailwind for pixel-perfect retail layouts.
Build an interactive order tracking timeline component (Submitted -> Packing -> Ready -> Picked Up).
Integrate the generated Unsplash image URLs as realistic store thumbnails.
For the Shopkeeper dashboard, ensure the 'Mark Ready' and 'Scan OTP' actions are massive, easily tappable buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use custom layered design elements with clear z-index.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for transform and colors.
Never use text-align: center globally in App.css.
Use 2-3x more spacing for empty states and sections to avoid a cramped feel.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use the lucide-react library.
Add hover and active micro-animations to all interactive elements.
